name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle, designed to travel on no more than three wheels, including any bicycle with a motor attached that isn't a motorized bicycle. A bicycle with an electric motor that can go faster than 30 mph, or a seated electric two-wheeler over that speed, is a motorcycle. Defined by Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1.
restrictions: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Includes any bicycle with a motor or driving wheel attached, other than a motorized bicycle (30 mph or slower) or an electric bicycle
Riders need a motorcycle license or endorsement; riders under 18 must also complete an approved motorcycle basic rider course
A motorcycle learner's permit doesn't allow passengers or riding between sunset and sunrise
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting the registrar's standards
The operator must wear glasses, goggles or a face shield unless it has a windshield or screen
Registered with the RMV, which requires proof of compulsory liability insurance
An off-road dirt bike ridden off public ways is a recreation vehicle instead
